statement: For every odd prime, every original cusp packet, and every permitted open Delta0, the full pro-l fixed subgroup on each stable S3 genus-two reflection quotient is exactly the selected cusp inertia. All exceptional D3 packets left by A.24 are included. The proof gives the all-degree kernel of m1 T1+m2 T2+lambda ad(Omega): Lie(omega1,omega2) if lambda=0, and Q_l Omega otherwise, when m1m2 is nonzero.
depends_on: A.25 stable reduction with component degrees(1,2); A.24 hyperelliptic equivariance and free-Lie centralizer; A.4 CM isogeny decomposition; Betts-Dogra Definition3.1.5 and Theorem3.1.6; explicit all-degree tensor-prefix normal form
notes: The divisor f*O=3P forces the cusp onto the node, so the pointed stable model has a rational bridge and two nonzero edge lengths. Actual versus model affine monodromy differs in degree two only by lambda ad(Omega), since both kill the boundary and D1=0. A first-core prefix normal form handles every lambda, including -m1 and -m2; when lambda=0, one actual CM Frobenius conjugate leaves only Omega. Integral primitivity and subtraction of an actual cusp power give the full group statement. The proof uses residue2 and asserts odd l only. No nonabelian injectivity is claimed for the three C3-to-D3 quotient maps, and the separate two-extreme-derivation kernel conjecture remains unproved.
